snippet.textDisplay:
Angry gameplan and angry blitz package from UGA.  

There are several teams who can put together a performance thats this dominant across all phases (probably Miami, TX, maybe Bama or TN, ND) but it’s a smaller list imo when the opponent is quality.  

Really tough to dominate a talented team like that at the line for a whole game and really never let them get back in it.  Usually there’s a period where it gets close again or the pressure lets up.  

All these top teams have flaws but that was a total demolition show

snippet.textDisplay:
@kablah777agreed, any team CAN lose. Two points. 
1- Earlier this season Pate along with numerous others personalities said that UGA was ranked lower because they hadn’t played anyone. They didn’t beat anyone, they weren’t tested. Applying the same test to Miami, the only real team they’ve played is ND and they lost. And it wasn’t close. 
2- Georgia has an Elite Offense and one of, if not THE best defense in college football. Assuming Miami’s offense is Elite, their defense is not even good. 

So, how can you pick against a team that has been tested, has beaten top teams, has Elite offense/defense when their opponent’s only test they lost and have an inconsistent defense at best?
